findings.issue: TaskCompleted hook entry point exists at scripts/hooks/entry/claude-code/task-completed.js but is NOT registered in .claude/settings.local.json. The withLock fix in handleTaskCompleted is unreachable dead code — Claude Code never invokes it.
findings.recommendation: Register TaskCompleted hook in settings.local.json and in the settings generator (flow-settings-generator.js).

findings.issue: Both writeFileSync calls (ready.json line 113, durable-history.json line 153) bypass writeJson() from flow-utils which provides atomic temp-rename. Crash mid-write can corrupt files despite lock. writeJson not imported.
findings.recommendation: Import writeJson and replace both fs.writeFileSync calls with writeJson(path, data).

findings.issue: writeFileSync inside withLock in addTasksToReadyJson bypasses writeJson() (already imported). Also missing trailing newline unlike task-completed.js.

writeFileSync failure inside withLock: in-memory ready object already mutated but catch only sets message. Phase reset and durable-history write proceed despite ready.json not being updated. History write (line 138-158) does NOT check result.completed before executing.
findings.recommendation: Guard history write with 'if (result.completed) { ... }' to prevent false-success cascading.

findings.issue: Uses process.cwd() for ready.json path instead of PATHS.state from flow-utils. PATHS not imported. Inconsistent with task-completed.js which uses PATHS correctly.
findings.recommendation: Add PATHS to import destructuring, use path.join(PATHS.state, 'ready.json').

findings.issue: stdin parsed with raw JSON.parse() instead of safeJsonParseString(). Violates security-patterns.md Rule #2. External process boundary input.
findings.recommendation: Use safeJsonParseString from flow-utils for stdin parsing.

findings.issue: inputTaskId from external stdin not validated with validateTaskId(). Unvalidated string flows to result.taskId and systemMessage.
async main() invoked bare without .catch(). Unhandled async rejections crash silently in Node 15+.
findings.recommendation: Change main() to main().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); }).

findings.issue: generateAndExportStories silently reports success when addTasksToReadyJson returns error object (duplicate detection). No error guard unlike finalizeDigestion.
findings.recommendation: Add error guard matching the one in finalizeDigestion.

findings.issue: addTasksToReadyJson can throw from withLock (lock timeout, permission error). Neither finalizeDigestion nor generateAndExportStories wrap the await in try/catch. Thrown exception propagates as unhandled rejection.
findings.recommendation: Wrap await addTasksToReadyJson in try/catch, return { error: ... } on failure.

findings.issue: err.message with absolute filesystem paths propagated to systemMessage/AI context via adapter.
findings.recommendation: Use generic error categories in result.message, log details to stderr only.

findings.issue: Empty catch swallows withLock failures for history write. No DEBUG logging path.
findings.recommendation: Add DEBUG log in catch block.
